decisions.reason: The reported mint and prize-pool values are evidence used to identify inaccurate leaderboard totals; they do not change the existing requirement that public platform statistics match completed mints and the actual pool balance.
The source concerns aggregate ticket and commission totals on the leaderboard, not reward values displayed for an individual NFT.
Leaderboard reward totals do not alter which successfully minted NFTs must appear in a user's dashboard listing.
The source requires accurate aggregate leaderboard totals but does not change the NFT metadata ticket-counter structure.
The source identifies an error in leaderboard totals and does not change the existing dashboard requirement to display the user's referrals, tickets, and prizes accurately.
Ticket and commission totals on the leaderboard are unrelated to NFT cover, image, metadata, or wallet presentation.
The source does not address metadata or asset endpoint resolution.
The source reports inaccurate runtime leaderboard totals but does not direct any change to approved FAQ content.
The leaderboard discrepancy does not revise the About page's description of referral, ticket, commission, or prize mechanics.
The source concerns aggregate leaderboard accounting and does not change how fiat buyers receive or access commissions, tickets, or prizes.
The source does not change how referral codes, badges, or active and expired tickets behave when an NFT is transferred.
The source reports incorrect leaderboard totals and does not request any change to landing-page hero copy or layout.
